evidence.text: Implemented web API endpoints for creating invoices and processing refunds.
Authored SQL joins and transactions for invoice reconciliation.
Created automated integration tests for unsuccessful payments.
Kept the deployed billing service running and repaired production failures.
I created a warehouse inventory REST API.
SQL stock lookup queries were written and optimized by me.
I wrote an automated regression test suite for inventory transfers.
The production inventory service for multiple warehouses was maintained by me.
Following a retail job, I developed an ordering tool with a web API.
I authored SQL queries for saving and retrieving orders.
Automated duplicate-order tests were implemented by me.
My ordering software is used every week by three shops.
As a self-taught programmer I implemented the API for a neighborhood equipment-loan application.
I wrote the SQL queries that access its database.
I added automated reservation tests.
My neighbors borrow equipment using the software I built.
I performed physics research by writing numerical simulations.
I created an API for simulation outputs.
I authored the SQL queries used to retrieve results.
I implemented automated tests for that service.
Not only did I develop a REST API for laboratory measurements, but I also wrote SQL queries for filtering experiment records.
I authored automated unit and integration tests.
I carried out computational biology research with software I developed.
A food bank uses my scheduling software to coordinate volunteers.
I implemented the HTTP API for the scheduling system.
I authored SQL queries to find available volunteers.
I wrote an automated test suite covering shift conflicts.
I created a clinic scheduling product used daily by its employees.
I implemented the product's REST API.
I authored SQL queries for managing appointments.
I wrote automated tests for unusual scheduling situations.
My work was talent acquisition for developers specializing in REST APIs, SQL, automated software testing, and production services. I did not perform any of their programming or operations work.
Building an API, writing SQL and automated tests, and deploying a service are learning goals for next summer. None of these projects has been begun.
I lack any experience implementing APIs, writing SQL queries or automated software tests. I have no experience maintaining a production service or creating software for users.
External developers implemented the API, database queries and automated tests for the product I financed. Those developers operate the service. I have no programming or operations experience.
